versions.changelog: v3.3.27: Fix room topics (now uses room description instead of noisy keyword extraction); remove project auto-detection singleton to fix stale project slug in long sessions; fix awareness truncation at section boundaries; fix listAllProjects missing smart-named journal files (3 projects were invisible to MCP tools)
Fix OpenClaw security scanner flags: add install spec, security section, soften prompt-override language
Add MCP prompts (arstart/arsave/arsaveall/recall-context), awareness resources, multi-window conflict prevention, Obsidian frontmatter, LobeHub badge, benchmarked token savings

- Added new documentation files: README.md and command docs for /arsave and /arstart.
- Improved recall ranking details: now explains use of Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and Ebbinghaus decay for journal entries.
- Feedback for recall is now clarified as using a Bayesian Beta model for optimal usefulness estimation.
- SKILL.md and docs now updated to reflect these technical and workflow clarifications.

- Removed README.md file from the repository.
- No changes to core functionality or instructions.

- Added a README.md providing documentation and usage information for the skill.
- No changes to code or functionality—documentation update only.

- Initial release of agent-recall: persistent, compounding memory system for AI agents.
- Provides 5 key MCP tools: session_start, remember, recall, session_end, and check.
- Features automatic content classification, semantic auto-naming, correction capture, and cross-project insight matching.
- Stores all data as local markdown—no cloud, no telemetry; fully Obsidian-compatible.
- Supports multiple agent platforms via simple installation and broad trigger phrase coverage.
